detail: OPTIONS 探测 http://127.0.0.1:8090：11 条代表路由；product=SUPPORTED；user=SUPPORTED；order=SUPPORTED；refund=SUPPORTED；behavior=UNDETERMINED；reset_state=UNDETERMINED；admin=SUPPORTED。路由明细：/api/v1/mall/products=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/mall/users=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/mall/orders=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/mall/orders/0/pay=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/mall/orders/0/cancel=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/mall/orders/0/refunds=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/mall/refunds/0/complete=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/admin/products=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/admin/products/0/price=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/admin/products/0/stock=HTTP_ANSWERED(200), /api/v1/admin/products/0/status=HTTP_ANSWERED(200)。已按凭据引用 GENERATOR_TARGET_TOKEN 取值并对所有代表路由附带（值不回显）。behavior 需在 config_json.behavior_path 声明公开行为埋点接口路径（参考商城尚无该接口，路径未冻结，B-04）。reset_state 需在 config_json.reset_path 声明受保护重置接口路径
